name: harness-memory-suite
description: Memory, knowledge, skills and scoped capability orchestration for a compatible Harness host.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=dsh-fileman && npm run build:media
scripts.test: npm run test:compat && npm run test:memory && npm run test:knowledge && npm run test:files && npm run test:policy && npm run test:activation && npm run test:media
scripts.verify: npm run check:privacy && npm run check:syntax && npm test
scripts.build:media: npm run build --workspace=dsh-image-studio && npm run build --workspace=dsh-video-studio && npm run build --workspace=dsh-image-workshop && npm run build --workspace=dsh-live-film
scripts.test:media: node --test packages/image-studio/*.test.mjs packages/image-studio/fixed-editor/tests/*.test.mjs packages/video-studio/*.test.mjs packages/live-film/tests/*.test.mjs packages/image-workshop/tests/*.test.mjs packages/dsh-remote-links/*.test.mjs packages/dsh-launchpad/*.test.mjs packages/file-manager/media-operations.test.mjs
